svg.title: Heineke-Mikulicz geometry
svg.desc: A longitudinal incision across a short narrowing is closed transversely, widening the local lumen while shortening the segment. The closure axis rotates; the organ itself is not rotated. Tissue mobility, vascularity and appropriate defect selection limit this geometric principle. View: Generic luminal repair, conceptual sequence. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: EAU Urethral Strictures: disease management in males (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urethral-strictures/chapter/disease-management-in-males; access: official full text; Indications and reconstructive principles; not a validation of every drawn tissue plane. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: Heineke-Mikulicz principle — incise long, close transverse
a longitudinal cut across a short narrowing, closed at 90° — the waist widens, the segment shortens slightly
